channel.description: Aggregated, filtered feed of calls for papers and conference announcements relevant to applied linguistics, crawled and pulled from LINGUIST List, Ling Alert, WikiCFP and other sources.

item.title: [LINGUIST List — Conference Announcements] Confs: Panel at IPC20 - Toxic Language: Pragmatics of Harm
item.description: Organizer: Xi Chen (Nanyang Technological University) Lucien Brown (Monash University) Language has the capacity to cause profound social and interpersonal harm. Through interaction and discourse, individuals and groups may be excluded, dehumanised, stigmatised, marginalised, or subjected to moral condemnation and social control.
